note: Positive: TestRFC7296ChildRekeyRequestCarriesTheOfferNonceAndSelectors decrypts ze's initiateChildRekey request at the peer: exactly one SA, one Ni, one TSi and one TSr with selectors, KEi present with pfs enable and absent with pfs disable (the optional clause both ways). Negative (receive side): TestRFC7296ChildRekeyRequestMissingAPayloadIsRefused removes SA, Ni, TSi or TSr one at a time from a peer request: each refused with errMalformedRequest and INVALID_SYNTAX, nothing installed; the complete request is answered. TestRekeyWithoutTrafficSelectorsIsRefused (moved from 2.9-1) adds the no-TS request refusal and its answered twin.
